one_change_rules.layer-2-bytes: Serialize only for this test using the transform's exact test-only profile, replace exactly one occurrence of old bytes, and require the result to contain exactly one duplicate object name. This defines no production representation or canonical production bytes.
one_change_rules.layer-3-document: Apply exactly one declared candidate RFC6901 operation to the complete admitted baseline document; object order is ignored and every array remains literal and ordered.
one_change_rules.layer-4-typed: After shape admission exactly one declared candidate semantic leaf or relationship differs; the oracle and expected outcome are byte-for-byte unchanged.
one_change_rules.layer-5-coverage: Reconstruction remains conforming and exactly one declared candidate coverage value or occurrence differs; the oracle and expected outcome are byte-for-byte unchanged.
one_change_rules.layer-6-appraisal: Reconstruction and coverage remain conforming and exactly one declared candidate appraisal stimulus differs; the oracle and expected outcome are byte-for-byte unchanged.
